dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: #Oh hey, {NICKNAME}, you're back!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: So, how goes the journey? Give me all the details.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you settling in okay?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Haha, don't worry, I'll be fine. Believe me, I can feel at home almost anywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: By the way, I really like what you've done with the place... Especially that funny little bird at the entrance...

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Gotcha, Tubby the Teapot Spirit... Wait, what?

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: I've heard my share of stories, everything from fox envoys, to bake-danuki, to tengu warriors... But a teapot spirit? That's a new one.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Hmm, interesting. So, that teapot youkai... I mean, spirit. Teapot spirit. Did you catch it yourself?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's a long story. Rest assured, Tubby is no youkai.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Not a youkai? So... just out of curiosity, this Tubby doesn't happen to be some sort of god or anything, does it?

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: That would spell the end for me... I, uh, couldn't help but pat it on the head when I came in...

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Gotcha, Tubby the Butler Bird... Wait, what?

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: You're saying you've got a bird that's smart enough to be a butler? It's not some kind of youkai or anything... Is it?

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Heh, you never cease to impress me. I mean, taming youkai? Who knew you had that kind of talent!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Sure! The atmosphere here's really relaxed. It's perfect for chatting the day away.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: By the way, I've been hoping to show you around the Grand Narukami Shrine when we get the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: The Sacred Sakura at the shrine is in bloom year-round. Seeing the falling blossoms dance in the wind is quite a sight to behold... definitely a surefire way to make you fall in love with Inazuma.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Haha, great!

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: And speaking of the Grand Narukami Shrine, one word of advice... Don't ever attack any of the kitsune nearby.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Not that you'd ever dream of doing something like that... would you?

choices.text: Of course not, I always respect the wildlife.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Ah, that's good. I always knew that you were a kindhearted person.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: I know an old lady who loves telling stories about the unnatural. She told me that someone was once sentenced to "judgment by lightning" after attacking one of the kitsune near the shrine.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Kitsune are highly favored by the Grand Narukami, so I guess the offender only got what was coming to them.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Regardless, you should probably try not to provoke any animals you encounter, regardless of the species.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: All plants and creatures equally deserve our respect.

choices.text: ...Why, what's the worst that could happen?

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Huh, you're not seriously considering it, are you? Trust me, don't let curiosity get the best of you. Attacking a kitsune is bad luck.

choices.text: I'd love to join you next time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Actually, I was hoping to find a nice, open area and invite you to do some skygazing together.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Something about the sky here seems clearer than anywhere else. It makes me feel... peaceful inside.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Don't get me wrong, sunset in Inazuma is impressive, too, but somehow it feels a little more... somber than what you have here.

choices.text: Well, we are inside an adeptus' teapot, after all.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Huh, you're right... which is already pretty astonishing. To think that the two of us along with a whole expanse of sky can be packed inside a tiny little teapot.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Ahhhh...

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Even if this crystal-blue sky is just a teapot's illusion, a moment of pure tranquility is a great thing all the same.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Haha, I guess I always try to see the positive side of things.

choices.text: I appreciate that about you, Thoma.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Haha, thanks for that.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: On a more serious note, though you may not want to show it... I can see the tiring toll of your journey in your eyes sometimes.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Since we're already here, why not try to leave your worries behind and put your mind at ease for a while?

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: And if you ever feel lonely, don't worry — you've always got me here to keep you company.

choices.text: That's why you can live a happy life.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Really? You do? It's great that you know how I feel.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Morning, Thoma.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: #Morning, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: If you'd like some breakfast, I'd be more than happy to whip something up for ya.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Night, Thoma.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: #Night, {NICKNAME}! Try not to kick off all your covers, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: See you tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Nice teahouse you've got here. I can see you put a lot of thought into the furniture and teaware.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Personally, I think a few pets would complete the atmosphere... What do you say?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Oh, and don't worry, you can leave them to me to take care of.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Great job here, you really know what you're doing! If you placed this in Inazuma, you could probably steal a good chunk of business from Hanamizaka.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Shame I can't flex my "fixer" muscles around here. In other words... no discounts for Thoma.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I won't let that affect our outings here though. Food and drink's on me, hehe.
